art.title: Luncheon of the Boating Party
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons
art.story: Lunch is over on the balcony of the Maison Fournaise, a restaurant by the river Seine where people came to row and sail. Under the striped awning, Renoir gathered his friends: they lean on the railing, flirt, drink the last of the wine among bottles and grapes. The young woman cooing at a little dog on the left is Aline, who later became his wife; the man in the straw hat, straddling his chair on the right, is the painter Gustave Caillebotte.
